const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "set -euo pipefail
base='evidence/quality/repair-window-15-20260923'
manifest='.ai/task/repair-w15-20260923/PACK-MANIFEST.json'
mkdir -p "$base/orchestration"
jq -r '.files[] | [.source,.relative_destination,.sha256,(.bytes|tostring)] | @tsv' "$manifest" | while IFS=$'\t' read -r src dst expected bytes; do
  actual=$(sha256sum "$src" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  size=$(wc -c < "$src")
  if [ "$actual" != "$expected" ] || [ "$size" != "$bytes" ]; then
    echo "source mismatch: $src" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  target="$base/orchestration/$dst"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"
  if [ -e "$target" ]; then
    if ! cmp -s "$src" "$target"; then
      echo "existing target differs: $target" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  else
    cp -- "$src" "$target"
  fi
done
cp -- "$manifest" "$base/orchestration-pack-manifest.json"
candidate='.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window15-20260923-candidate-catalog'
find "$candidate" -type f -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' src; do
  rel=${src#"$candidate"/}
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$rel")"
  cp -- "$src" "$rel"
done
migration_target='evidence/production-review-v2-lite/migrations/de68e389782940517c064da7cdaaa19d6207e7dc1da4c1ca4dc5728b05e25d71.json'
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$migration_target")"
cp -- '.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window15-20260923-migration.json' "$migration_target"
mkdir -p "$base/publication"
for name in PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json ADJUDICATION-R0.json ADJUDICATION-F1.json ADJUDICATION-R2.json ADJUDICATION-FINAL.json; do
  cp -- ".ai/task/repair-w15-20260923/$name" "$base/publication/$name"
done
for name in queue-1.log queue-1-timing.json catalog.log catalog-timing.json migration.json migration-timing.json migration-run.log migration-run-timing.json; do
  cp -- ".artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window15-20260923-$name" "$base/publication/$name"
done
printf 'snapshot_files=%s\n' "$(find "$base/orchestration" -type f | wc -l)"
printf 'publication_files=%s\n' "$(find "$base/publication" -type f | wc -l)"",
  workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
  yield_time_ms: 10000,
  max_output_tokens: 20000,
  sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
  justification: "允许我按已核验的 manifest 和 PUBLICATION-SCOPE，在授权路径内安装窗口 15 冻结快照、catalog、migration 与 publication 附件吗？"
});
text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "set -euo pipefail
base='evidence/quality/repair-window-15-20260923'
manifest='.ai/task/repair-w15-20260923/PACK-MANIFEST.json'
count=0
jq -r '.files[] | [.source,.relative_destination,.sha256,(.bytes|tostring)] | @tsv' "$manifest" | while IFS=$'\t' read -r src dst expected bytes; do
  target="$base/orchestration/$dst"
  test -f "$target"
  cmp -s "$src" "$target"
  actual=$(sha256sum "$target" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  size=$(wc -c < "$target")
  test "$actual" = "$expected"
  test "$size" = "$bytes"
done
test "$(find "$base/orchestration" -type f | wc -l)" -eq "$(jq '.files | length' "$manifest")"
cmp -s "$manifest" "$base/orchestration-pack-manifest.json"
printf '%s\n' 'PASS pack: 160 exact copies, SHA-256 and bytes match; manifest exact copy'
candidate='.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window15-20260923-candidate-catalog'
find "$candidate" -type f -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' src; do
  rel=${src#"$candidate"/}
  cmp -s "$src" "$rel"
done
test "$(find "$candidate" -type f | wc -l)" -eq 5
migration_target='evidence/production-review-v2-lite/migrations/de68e389782940517c064da7cdaaa19d6207e7dc1da4c1ca4dc5728b05e25d71.json'
cmp -s '.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window15-20260923-migration.json' "$migration_target"
test "$(jq -r '.catalog_id' evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog/manifest.json)" = 'f4d10da25eb9e968b74997635ef6bcb09cdaf25095caef96a3f220db494c660b'
test "$(jq -r '.migration_id' "$migration_target")" = 'de68e389782940517c064da7cdaaa19d6207e7dc1da4c1ca4dc5728b05e25d71'
printf '%s\n' 'PASS catalog: 5 exact copies; migration exact copy; IDs match'
for name in PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json ADJUDICATION-R0.json ADJUDICATION-F1.json ADJUDICATION-R2.json ADJUDICATION-FINAL.json; do
  cmp -s ".ai/task/repair-w15-20260923/$name" "$base/publication/$name"
done
for name in queue-1.log queue-1-timing.json catalog.log catalog-timing.json migration.json migration-timing.json migration-run.log migration-run-timing.json; do
  cmp -s ".artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window15-20260923-$name" "$base/publication/$name"
done
test "$(find "$base/publication" -type f | wc -l)" -eq 16
printf '%s\n' 'PASS publication attachments: 16 exact copies'
find "$base/orchestration" "$base/publication" -type f -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 "$file" >/dev/null; done
find evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog i18n/quality/production-review-v2-lite -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.json' -o -name '*.jsonl' \) -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 "$file" >/dev/null; done
iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 "$migration_target" >/dev/null
iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 "$base/PUBLICATION.md" >/dev/null
iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 handoff.md >/dev/null
if rg -n '[ \t]+$' "$base/PUBLICATION.md"; then exit 1; fi
git diff --check -- handoff.md
last_byte=$(tail -c 1 "$base/PUBLICATION.md" | od -An -t u1 | tr -d ' ')
test "$last_byte" = '10'
test -d "$base/publication"
test -f "$base/orchestration-pack-manifest.json"
test -f "$base/PUBLICATION.md"
test -f evidence/quality/production-batches/batch-b1809d747f471912638d-host-evidence/summary.md

printf '%s\n' '--- scoped status ---'
git status --short -- handoff.md "$base" evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog i18n/quality/production-review-v2-lite "$migration_target"
printf '%s\n' '--- tracked diff stat ---'
git diff --stat -- handoff.md evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog i18n/quality/production-review-v2-lite",
  workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",

});
